paragraphs.text: The air is cool, so Mia puts on a jacket. She and Sam tell Dad about Max. Dad and Ben go to the park with them. Mia is afraid. Where is Max?
They look near the trees and call his name. Ben sees a red leaf. A little brown ball is next to it. ‘Is this Max’s ball?’ he asks. Sam shakes his head.
Mia hears a sound. It comes from under a bench. Max is there, next to a little child. The child holds his collar. ‘I can’t find my dad,’ she says. Dad gets down beside the girl.
